bankerSummary: College student, not yet an FNB customer, no steady income. Income: $3,000 one-time summer savings, $2,000 per semester aid refund, $300/mo family support = about $1,133/mo effective. Fixed costs $650, debt payments $0 (57% of income), surplus $483/mo, savings $400, credit range: building. Spending plan: $226/mo savings, $257/mo guilt-free. Goals: travel ($2,500 in 12 months, P1, $69/mo of $209/mo needed); credit building ($500 est. in 12 months, P2, $28/mo of $42/mo needed); first home ($15,000 est. in 84 months, P3, $16/mo of $179/mo needed). Plan: now FNB Credit Center, FNB Student Checking, FNB FirstRate Savings, FNB Learning Center; next FNB Savers Goal CD; later FNB SmartSecured Credit Card, FNB Home Ownership Program.
